not_covered.text: Multiple people are injured in an alleged car ramming attack in Newcastle, Australia during a Newcastle Knights grand final procession. The driver is arrested at the scene.
Latvians vote to elect 100 seats of the Saeima amid an uptick of airspace incursions and hybrid warfare during the Russo-Ukrainian war.
Reuters reports that Saudi Arabia is planning a offensive on the Houthis in the coming weeks to take back the Bab al-Mandab Strait.
Sudan's armed forces announces that they have recaptured the North Kordofan town of al-Mazroub.
The death toll in the Rapid Support Forces drone attack on the University of Kordofan in El Obeid rises to 10.
A Russian drone strikes Pivdennyi Bridge in Kyiv, Ukraine, for forth time in two days.
The G7 countries announce a plan to release 100 million barrels of diesel and crude oil to combat rising fuel prices caused by the Iran war.
The U.S. National Park Service confirms that the Hōlei Sea Arch, located on Hawaii's Big Island, has collapsed into the Pacific Ocean.

French government ministers, including right-wing education minister Édouard Geffray, accuse the far-left of inciting the youth-led unrest across the country. Intelligence agencies briefing the government during a crisis meeting on the riot
Swiss president Guy Parmelin announces his resignation from the Federal Council effective December 31. Parliament is expected to elect his successor on 9 December.
